"recruit" => {
let treasury = treasury_cell(w);
let aid = w.entities.spawn("代理人", Some(&treasury), None);
```
and recruit ctx:
```
e.ctx.insert("region".into(), treasury.clone());
```
Wait — recruit block borrows: `let aid = w.entities.spawn(...)` then `w.entities.get_mut(&aid)` — treasury is a String local, fine. But there's a borrow issue: `treasury_cell(w)` needs &w — called before get_mut. Inside match arm of light_mandate, `w` is &mut World; treasury_cell(w) takes &World — reborrow OK.
But grain_gift: `w.material.spawn_at(..., &treasury, ...)` — spawn_at signature: (kind, amount, region, ?, ?, owner) — earlier calls pass &cell where cell: String → &String coerces to &str. treasury_cell(w) borrows w immutably while spawn_at needs &mut w.material — treasury is an owned String computed before, so no overlap. Good.
annex:
```rust
let treasury = treasury_cell(w);
let paid = w.material.consume_from_cell(&treasury, "库银", claim_cost);
if paid + 1e-9 < claim_cost {
if paid > 0.0 { w.material.spawn_at("库银", paid, &treasury, None, None, Some("朝廷")); }
return Err(format!("国库不足：收编需 {claim_cost} 实有 {paid:.1}"));
}
```
refund spot:
```rust
w.material.spawn_at("库银", claim_cost, &treasury, None, None, Some("朝廷"));
